name: Focus Quality Assessment and Ranking of Microscopy Image Series
description:
You are a microscopy core facility technician who needs to evaluate the focus quality of a batch of cell images. A folder of 8 TIFF microscopy images taken at different focus settings is located at ~/ImageJ_Data/focus_assessment/. Some images are sharply focused while others are blurry (out-of-focus).

Your task:
1. Open each TIFF image from ~/ImageJ_Data/focus_assessment/ in Fiji/ImageJ.
2. For each image, measure basic pixel intensity statistics: Mean, Standard Deviation (StdDev), Min, and Max.
3. Record the results in a CSV file at ~/ImageJ_Data/results/focus_quality_report.csv.
4. The CSV must have columns for: Filename (or Label), Mean, StdDev, Min, Max.
5. Sort the rows by StdDev in DESCENDING order (highest StdDev = sharpest focus first).
6. You must measure at least 6 of the 8 images.

Tip: Standard deviation of pixel intensities is a standard proxy for image sharpness — sharp images have high-contrast edges producing high StdDev, while blurry images have smoothed intensities with low StdDev.
